# ankra_ai_models (Data Source)

Lists the organisation's AI model catalogue, built-in entries included. The counterpart of `ankra ai models list`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_ai_models" "all" {}

output "enabled_model_keys" {
  value = [for model in data.ankra_ai_models.all.models : model.key if model.is_enabled]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source.
- `models` (Attributes List) Catalogue entries in picker order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--models))

<a id="nestedatt--models"></a>
### Nested Schema for `models`

Read-Only:

- `context_window_tokens` (Number) Context window in tokens.
- `description` (String) Short description.
- `display_name` (String) Name shown in the picker.
- `endpoint_id` (String) Endpoint the model is served from, if any.
- `id` (String) Row identifier; null for a built-in entry the organisation never changed.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether the key is a built-in tier key.
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the model is selectable.
- `key` (String) Catalogue key.
- `max_output_tokens` (Number) Maximum output tokens.
- `model_id` (String) Provider model id.
- `provider` (String) `ankra` or `openai_compatible`.
- `sort_order` (Number) Position in the picker.
- `supports_images` (Boolean) Whether the model accepts images.
- `supports_thinking` (Boolean) Whether the model has a thinking channel.
- `supports_tools` (Boolean) Whether the model supports tool calling.
- `tier` (String) Auto-routing tier, if any.
